root_sealing.seal_shape: UNCHANGED schemas/B0_CONTRACTS.schema.json RootSeal/RootSealBody/AuthorityManifest. No added wire/root fields or expanded descriptor enum.
root_sealing.root_binding: New separately sealed RootSeal.body embeds this exact existing C0 descriptor and this exact proposal-only AuthorityManifest. All other body fields match qualified C0 source/Core-only policy/backend/profile/identity/presentation manifests. Compute Htag(root,whole body) normally after B1 qualification; no actual root id is supplied here.
root_sealing.separation: This additional offline control is not the original config-C0 RootSeal. Its root id must differ from the original when other fields are held fixed. No existing descriptor, root_id, entity origin/id, binding, or admitted installation is changed.
root_sealing.scope: Fresh independently initialized fixture installation; literal descriptor world/lineage remain core-only. Existing canonical identities are reused only as original sealed C0 bindings, never recomputed from labels. Full root scope distinguishes this control; never import its authority into an original installation.
root_sealing.qualification: Root/source/backend/profile qualification is still mandatory. Pending documentary examples cannot be admitted. Invalid/missing proof remains O5; no test-only bypass.
root_sealing.authority_storage: Full AuthorityManifest is embedded in the existing RootSeal.body.authority_manifest and G7 root record, already committed by Htag(root,whole body). The standalone JSON is a review/input copy, not a new authority-artifact kind, authoritative sidecar, live grant file or added wire field. Preserve existing artifact-type grammar.

authority_interpretation.proposal_authority: RootSeal.body.authority_manifest.producers operations are permissions to submit typed proposals. In this exact separately approved C0 control human-H/1 may submit Send as H to P.
authority_interpretation.execution_authority: The embedded unchanged C0 descriptor still lists only advance/storage maintenance and has all social/Cog families absent. Proposal permission does not install a policy, enable an operation, supply a social family, or authorize communication performance.
authority_interpretation.narrow_precedence: For this control the separate manifest supplies the missing proposal permission; it does not inherit Send execution permission from C1. Scope/authentication, required qualification, new-key check, full current witness and complete preview commitments must all pass. The generic capability gate then returns O4 UNSUPPORTED before any social resolver, receiving/choice/Cog callback, staged social record or public outward emission.
authority_interpretation.no_missing_authorization_substitute: Using original config-C0 without the new sealed proposal manifest, wrong actual principal, or absent proposal permission is an authority control, not this UNSUPPORTED proof.
authority_interpretation.no_core_fixture_branch: Aliases/test ids are evidence labels only. Generic proposal permissions and capability availability determine admission; no Core rule may branch on T01, C0-control names, message words or fixture ids.
authority_interpretation.absent_manifest_sentinel: For all four absent families policy_id=absent is fixed absence metadata, never a loaded policy or required social artifact. G1 social/Cog rows remain absent.

complete_proposal.no_source_grant_gap: This exact Offer has root/certainty null, assertions/framing/source_fragments empty, terms null, amount0. All six bindings use unchanged B0-T02 recipes and the actual control-root current witness/Core-only bundle/profile. Do not transplant C1 hashes or recompile a rejected client Preview.
